question: What is the interest rate on HDFC personal loan?
answer: HDFC Personal Loan interest rate starts at 10.50% p.a. and varies based on CIBIL score, income, and employer category. Pre-approved customers get preferential rates.

question: What documents are required for a personal loan?
answer: PAN card, Aadhaar (KYC), last 3 months' salary slips, last 6 months' bank statement, and Form 16 or latest ITR. Self-employed need 2 years ITR + GST returns.

question: What is the processing fee for a personal loan?
answer: Processing fee is up to 2.50% of the loan amount, with a minimum of Rs. 1,999 and capped at Rs. 25,000 plus applicable GST. Pre-approved customers may get fee waivers.

question: What is the maximum personal loan amount?
answer: Personal loan amount ranges from Rs. 50,000 up to Rs. 40 lakh, subject to eligibility based on income, CIBIL score, and employer category.

question: What is the personal loan tenure?
answer: Personal loan tenure is flexible from 12 months to 72 months (6 years). Longer tenure means lower EMI but higher total interest paid.

question: How is EMI calculated on a personal loan?
answer: EMI depends on loan amount, interest rate, and tenure. Example: Rs. 5 lakh at 11% for 5 years = approx Rs. 10,871 per month. Use the HDFC EMI calculator for an exact figure.

question: What are the eligibility criteria for a personal loan?
answer: Salaried: age 21-60, minimum monthly income Rs. 25,000 (metro) / Rs. 20,000 (non-metro), minimum 2 years' work experience. Self-employed: age 25-65, business vintage 4+ years, profitable ITRs.

question: Is there a prepayment or foreclosure charge?
answer: Part-prepayment allowed after 12 EMIs at up to 4% on the principal prepaid. Full foreclosure also attracts 2-4% on outstanding principal plus GST. Charges depend on tenure completed.

question: What is the minimum CIBIL score required for a personal loan?
answer: Minimum CIBIL score of 700 is recommended. Score of 750+ gets the best interest rates. Below 700, the loan may still be approved but at a higher rate.

question: How long does personal loan approval take?
answer: For pre-approved customers, disbursal is in 10 seconds via NetBanking. For new customers, typical approval is 1-4 working days after document submission.

question: What is the interest rate on HDFC business loan?
answer: HDFC Business Loan interest rate starts at 10.75% p.a. and goes up to 22.50% depending on business vintage, turnover, CIBIL, and loan amount.

question: What is the maximum business loan amount?
answer: Business loan amount is up to Rs. 75 lakh (collateral-free) for SMEs. Higher amounts require collateral. Loan tenure is up to 48 months.

question: What documents are required for a business loan?
answer: PAN, Aadhaar, business proof (GST cert/Shop Act), last 2 years ITR with computation, last 1 year bank statements, balance sheet & P&L. Business vintage of 3+ years required.

question: Is collateral required for HDFC business loan?
answer: No, business loans up to Rs. 75 lakh are collateral-free for eligible SMEs. For higher amounts or under specific schemes, property collateral may be required.

question: What is the eligibility for a business loan?
answer: Self-employed professionals or proprietors aged 21-65 with business vintage of 3+ years, minimum annual turnover Rs. 40 lakh, and profitable ITR for the last 2 years.

question: What is the difference between personal loan and business loan?
answer: Personal Loan: salaried/professionals, up to Rs. 40 lakh, end-use unrestricted. Business Loan: self-employed/businesses, up to Rs. 75 lakh, end-use must be business-related, requires business vintage & ITR.

question: Why is your interest rate so high?
answer: Our rate reflects your CIBIL profile, income, and tenure. For pre-approved customers and 750+ CIBIL we offer rates as low as 10.50%. Let me check if you qualify for a better slab.

question: I already have a loan with another bank
answer: We can offer a balance transfer at a lower rate plus a top-up if your repayment record is clean. Existing EMI obligation is factored into your eligibility (FOIR).

question: Can I get a pre-approved offer?
answer: Yes — log into HDFC NetBanking or the MyApps app to check your pre-approved offers. Pre-approved customers get instant disbursal and waived processing fees.

question: What is foreclosure?
answer: Foreclosure means closing the loan before its scheduled end date by paying the full outstanding principal. Charges apply (2-4%) depending on completed tenure.

question: What is NACH mandate?
answer: NACH (National Automated Clearing House) mandate authorizes HDFC to auto-debit your EMI from your bank account on the due date. It is mandatory and set up during disbursal.

question: What if my EMI bounces?
answer: EMI bounce attracts a cheque bounce charge (typically Rs. 550 + GST) plus 2% per month penal interest on the overdue amount. Repeated bounces hurt CIBIL.

question: Can I apply if I have low CIBIL score?
answer: With CIBIL below 700, loan approval is harder and the rate will be higher. Adding a co-applicant with a strong CIBIL or pledging FD collateral improves chances.

question: Do you offer loan against property?
answer: Yes, HDFC Loan Against Property (LAP) is available up to Rs. 10 crore against residential or commercial property. Tenure up to 15 years, rates start at 9.50% p.a.

question: How can I check my loan application status?
answer: Track your application via HDFC NetBanking, the MyApps mobile app, or by calling 1800-202-6161 with your application reference number.
